top_signal.title: How do u deal with such demoralisation when running a business?
top_signal.summary: So I built a SaaS product for a problem i genuinely faced in my previous job. I think i’m just a tad bit late given that tools like claude, chatgpt etc have improved so much.   Still i kinda ignored that, bcz I had built a toy version of this during a company hackathon and I won prizes and saw so many users using it internally. Bcz of that I thought, there could be a chance of building a great product around this.    So I built my savings, had some runway and quit the job, learned how to build it properly..and I built a v0 which genuinely solved so much problem that i was facing. Then i packaged it into a product that other people can use.    Launched the v0 for free, reached out to my network and politely asked them if they could give it a try. They all said it was cool, will give it a try. But none of them did. I even followed up with couple of em and they said the same thing again. All my users now are just friends whose feedbacks don’t really matter bcz they are not the intended users.   I’m so demoralised. This is my second attempt at building a business. The first one was kind of a vitamin problem and nice to have product. So it was really hard to get users. This time i thought i genuinely had cracked a painkiller problem and atleast i would get the initial users fast so that I can iterate on their feedback.    Now I’m kinda depressed. Kinda unsure. I know there are still other marketing channels I could try, but the first channel I thought..which was people whom I knew
